description: This file defines classes and structures related to Bluetooth SDP (Service Discovery Protocol) over Bluetooth, including Payload management, PDU (Protocol Data Unit) handling, and socket communication classes for client and server roles.

classes.name: Payload
classes.description: Represents a Bluetooth SDP payload, providing methods to push and pop various data types and structures.

classes.name: PDU
classes.description: Represents a Bluetooth SDP Protocol Data Unit, including serialization, deserialization, and string representation.

classes.name: ClientSocket
classes.description: Manages Bluetooth SDP client socket communication, including sending and receiving PDUs.

classes.name: ServerSocket
classes.description: Manages Bluetooth SDP server socket communication, handling incoming PDUs and sending responses.

methods.name: Push
methods.description: Methods to push various data types into the Payload buffer.

methods.name: Pop
methods.description: Methods to extract various data types from the Payload buffer.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the PDU into a byte stream for transmission.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes a byte stream into a PDU object.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Sets the PDU type and payload content.

methods.name: AsString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the PDU.
